newsitem.title: USA: Yields edge down on Bond Buyer's weekly indices.
newsitem.headline: Yields edge down on Bond Buyer's weekly indices.

text.p: Yields on the Bond Buyer municipal bond indices slipped this week.
The yield on the 20-bond index of general obligation bonds calculated Thursday, Oct 17, was 5.72 percent, down one basis point from last Thursday.
The yield on the 11-bond index of GO bonds was 5.62 percent, down one basis point from last Thursday.
The yield on the 30-year revenue bond index was 5.97
percent, down two basis points from last Thursday.
